channel.title: CulinaryVault
channel.description: The world's 658 most famous recipes, tested and explained

item.title: Rosemary Focaccia
item.description: No-knead rosemary focaccia with a crisp olive-oil base and open, airy crumb. An overnight cold rise does the work for you.

item.title: Margherita Pizza
item.description: Authentic Margherita pizza with a blistered 24-hour dough, San Marzano sauce and fior di latte — pizzeria results from a home oven.

item.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
item.description: Authentic Roman spaghetti carbonara with guanciale, Pecorino and egg yolks. No cream, no scrambling — a silky sauce in 20 minutes.

item.title: Lasagna Bolognese
item.description: Classic lasagna Bolognese with a slow three-hour ragù, silky besciamella and egg pasta layers. The definitive Sunday bake.

item.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
item.description: Authentic fettuccine Alfredo made with only butter, Parmigiano and pasta water — no cream, no flour, ready in 15 minutes.

item.title: Cacio e Pepe
item.description: Foolproof cacio e pepe with a Pecorino slurry technique that guarantees a creamy, clump-free Roman sauce in 15 minutes.

item.title: Penne all'Arrabbiata
item.description: Fiery penne all'arrabbiata with slow-bloomed garlic and dried chilli. Naturally vegan, on the table in 20 minutes.

item.title: Risotto alla Milanese
item.description: Golden saffron risotto alla Milanese with the classic mantecatura finish for a rippling, restaurant-style texture.

item.title: Osso Buco alla Milanese
item.description: Slow-braised osso buco alla Milanese with fall-apart veal shanks, silky marrow and a bright lemon gremolata finish.

item.title: Chicken Parmigiana
item.description: Crispy chicken parmigiana that stays crunchy under the cheese — the restaurant technique of saucing lightly and grilling fast.

item.title: Potato Gnocchi with Sage Butter
item.description: Light, pillowy potato gnocchi with brown butter and sage. The baked-potato method that keeps them from turning gluey.

item.title: Japanese Cotton Cheesecake
item.description: Jiggly Japanese cotton cheesecake — light as a soufflé, barely sweet, baked in a water bath so it never cracks.

item.title: Pesto alla Genovese
item.description: Authentic pesto alla Genovese with basil, pine nuts and two cheeses — the technique that keeps it vivid green, not brown.

item.title: Minestrone Soup
item.description: Hearty Italian minestrone soup with a slow soffritto base, cannellini beans and seasonal vegetables. Naturally vegan.

item.title: Caprese Salad
item.description: Classic Caprese salad with buffalo mozzarella, ripe tomatoes and basil. Five minutes, three ingredients, done properly.

item.title: Tomato Bruschetta
item.description: Authentic tomato bruschetta with garlic-rubbed grilled bread and salted tomatoes. The classic Italian appetiser in 20 minutes.

item.title: Sicilian Arancini
item.description: Crispy Sicilian arancini with a molten mozzarella and ragù centre — the classic street-food rice balls, made from scratch.

item.title: Classic Tiramisu
item.description: Authentic tiramisu with cooked zabaglione, espresso-soaked savoiardi and mascarpone cream. No gelatine, no raw eggs.

item.title: Vanilla Panna Cotta
item.description: Silky vanilla panna cotta with the perfect wobble — a five-ingredient Italian dessert that takes 15 minutes to make.

item.title: Beef Bourguignon
item.description: Classic beef bourguignon braised three hours in red wine with lardons, pearl onions and mushrooms. The definitive French stew.

item.title: Coq au Vin
item.description: Traditional coq au vin with wine-marinated chicken, lardons and pearl onions in a glossy, reduced red wine sauce.

item.title: French Onion Soup
item.description: Deeply caramelised French onion soup with a Gruyère-crusted baguette raft. The slow-onion method that makes all the difference.

item.title: Provençal Ratatouille
item.description: Traditional Provençal ratatouille where each vegetable is cooked separately for perfect texture. Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

item.title: Marseille Bouillabaisse
item.description: Authentic Marseille bouillabaisse with a saffron fish-bone broth, mixed fish and garlicky rouille croutons.

item.title: Cassoulet de Toulouse
item.description: Traditional cassoulet de Toulouse with white beans, duck confit and sausage, baked slowly until a golden crust forms.
